column3: NKJV has “the high priest,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the chief priests.”
NKJV has “more than ten days,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “not more than eight or ten days.”
NKJV includes “to destruction,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “of such things as I supposed,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “of such evil things as I supposed.”
